tier_reason: First-party talk material opened in the CppCon/CppCon2025 presentations repository shows a small FP64 win over OpenBLAS on Zen 5 (1.70 vs 1.58 TFLOPS); no code, CPU model, size or compiler, so C.

corrections.claimed_speedup: CppCon 2025 keynote slides: FP64 GEMM 1.70 TFLOPS vs OpenBLAS 1.58 (~1.08x, derived) with zen5_packed_kernel on 16 cores at 5.7 GHz; FP32 ties OpenBLAS (3.57 vs 3.57); bf16 3.09 TFLOPS with no OpenBLAS figure. The C++Now 2025 slides on an i5-6300HQ show OpenBLAS ahead (154.1 vs 142.2 GFLOPS).
